title: 第十一章 出现在现实的梦魔第十二章 张威诡异
slug: 诡异复苏我以诡异打造世界
content_zh:
在那一头梦魔被磨灭，融入梦境世界的时候。
陆羽所掌控的恐惧之力等级，也是微微跳动了一下，无论是强度还是范围，都是变得更加强大了一些。
如果说之前的恐惧之力扩散的范围，可以在那梦境光雾之中达到八九米的距离，在现实达到三米的距离。
那么现在，恐惧之力扩散的范围，在梦境光雾之中，已经可以达到十一二米的距离。
在现实世界，也可以达到四米左右。
看看充斥虚空的光雾，陆羽不由有些沉默。
他吞噬了那么多的光雾，也确实增加了一些力量，但是其根本，似乎并没有增强多少，甚至没有增长。
而现在，不过杀死融合了，一头最最低级的初生梦魔，便就有了明显的增长。
那么是不是说，他在接下来，主要还是要放在这些梦魔身上的。
至于吞噬光雾，单纯的增长一些能量，似乎变的并不是那么重要了。
陆羽睁开双眼，看看外界已经朦胧亮的天色，陷入了沉思之中，他应该去哪里寻找梦魔？而且还要是弱小的梦魔。
否则的话，谁是猎人谁是猎物，那可就不好说了。
“烦死了！”
苦思无果，陆羽不由烦躁的放弃继续思考下去，而是再次闭上双眼，享受着那一股，依旧若有若无传来的恐惧之力。
嗯，隔壁的夫妻俩，已经没有恐惧之力反馈了，包括那被恐惧力场留下的印记链接，也已经彻底的消散断开。
只剩下了最后的那一个女孩，依旧在不时的反馈着，一股又一股的恐惧之力。
虽然不多，但是胜在源源不断。
而根据其联系方向，似乎...
陆羽猛的睁开双眼，看向了楼上。
“呃...不会那么巧吧？”

看着上方昏暗朦胧的白色天花板，陆羽心中充满无语。
没想到那个做噩梦，又被自己直接吓醒的女孩，竟然就是楼上的邻居。
不过，这距离也差的太多了吧？
他虽然不知道自己，在那梦境光雾之中走了多远。
但是，就是根据现实时间，大半夜的时间来算，以他在梦境之中的速度，怎么也要有着一二十里路了吧？
而这还不算上，梦境现实的时间差距呢。
这么一算的话，那就更加夸张了。
然而事实上，他与那个女孩梦境之间的距离，竟然只是楼上楼下。
这样一计算的话，陆羽彻底放弃了，在梦境寻找梦魔的打算。
实在是付出与收益，完全不成比例啊。
好家伙，几十、几百里的路程，才有可能寻到一处梦境，有可能发现一头梦魔。
注意，这还只是有可能。
而更大的可能，却是毫无收获。
所以在以后，除了碰巧遇到的，他便不用在那梦境光雾之中，特意寻找梦魔的存在了。
嗯，在现实世界吓吓那些昆虫动物，亦或者是恐吓一下，那些现实世界的恶徒，也是能够获得一些不菲的恐惧力量的。
至于实力的提升，反正他现在又不急，总是能够提升上来的。
就是靠着他自己，他感觉也用不了多长时间，便能够将梦境世界再一次的完善，提升一个档次。
甚至说，陆羽在吞噬了那些梦境光雾之后，便已经有了一些头绪。
在他的设想之中，世界的完善更进一步，那自然是需要能量的了。
而他接下来，便是需要获取足够能量，以及定义梦境世界的最初能量性质。

也就是说，他希望那梦境世界的最初能量，拥有什么样的能力、特点等等。
比如太阳的炽热、大地的厚重等等。
content_en:
When the dream demon was wiped out and merged into the dream world.
The level of fear power controlled by Lu Yu also jumped slightly, becoming stronger in both intensity and range.
If we look at the scope of the spread of the previous fear power, it can reach a distance of eight or nine meters in the dream light mist, and a distance of three meters in reality.
So now, the scope of the spread of the power of fear can reach a distance of eleven or two meters in the dream light mist.
In the real world, it can also reach about four meters.
Looking at the light mist filling the void, Lu Yu couldn't help but feel a little silent.
He devoured so much light mist, and indeed gained some strength, but at its root, it didn't seem to have strengthened much, or even increased.
But now, just by killing and merging, a most low-level newborn dream demon has grown significantly.
Does that mean that in the future, he will mainly focus on these dream demons.
As for swallowing the light mist, simply increasing some energy does not seem to be that important anymore.
Lu Yu opened his eyes, looked at the hazy sky outside, and fell into deep thought. Where should he go to find the dream demon? And it must be a weak dream demon.
Otherwise, it would be hard to say who is the hunter and who is the prey.
"So annoying!"
After thinking hard to no avail, Lu Yu couldn't help but irritably give up and continue thinking. Instead, he closed his eyes again and enjoyed the power of fear that was still vaguely present.
Well, the couple next door have no feedback from the power of fear, including the imprinted link left by the fear force field, which has also been completely dissipated and disconnected.
Only the last girl was left, still sending out waves of fear from time to time.
Although it's not much, the wins come in a steady stream.
And based on its contact direction, it seems...
Lu Yu suddenly opened his eyes and looked upstairs.
"Uh...it can't be such a coincidence, right?"
Looking at the dim white ceiling above, Lu Yu was speechless.
Unexpectedly, the girl who had a nightmare and was woken up by him was actually the neighbor upstairs.
However, this distance is too different, right?
Although he didn't know how far he had traveled in the light and mist of the dream.
However, even based on real time, most of the night, at the speed he was traveling at in the dream, it would still be ten or twenty miles away, right?
And that doesn't even count the time gap between dream and reality.
If you calculate it this way, it is even more exaggerated.
However, in fact, the distance between him and the girl's dream was only upstairs and downstairs.
Based on this calculation, Lu Yu completely gave up his plan to look for the dream demon in the dream.
It is true that the effort and benefit are completely out of proportion.
Good guy, it takes dozens or hundreds of miles to find a dreamland and discover a dream monster.
Note that this is only a possibility.
The greater possibility is that there is nothing to gain.
Therefore, in the future, except for those he encounters by chance, he will no longer have to look for the existence of dream demons in the mist of dreams.
Well, by scaring those insects and animals in the real world, or by intimidating the villains in the real world, you can also gain some considerable fear power.
As for the improvement of strength, he is not in a hurry now and can always improve.
Even relying on himself, he feels that it won't take long to perfect the dream world again and raise it to a higher level.
It is even said that Lu Yu already had some clues after swallowing the dream light mist.
In his vision, the world would be further perfected, which would naturally require energy.
Next, he needs to obtain enough energy and the initial energy properties that define the dream world.
In other words, he hopes that the initial energy of the dream world will haveWhat abilities, characteristics, etc. are there?
For example, the heat of the sun, the thickness of the earth, etc.
